name: parapetai-mcp
summary: MCP server for Claude Code (and other MCP clients): device-code login to a Parapet control plane, provisioning agents, and pulling the exact quickstart config a codebase needs -- ships six packaged skills: parapet-maf/parapet-adk (retrofit an existing project per framework), parapet-quickdemo (generate a demo from nothing), parapet-install-prereqs (install Python/pipx/uv), and parapet-audit/parapet-audit-fix (scan for ungoverned model/tool calls, then wrap them in GovernedAgent/GovernedRunner).
author: Parapet
